summary: Prepare for CBAM reporting with product-scope checks, supplier data workflows and evidence tools. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: CBAM reporting training helps export, manufacturing, supply-chain and compliance professionals organize product-scope checks and emissions evidence for buyer reporting. Participants practise requesting supplier data, tracking production records and evidence sources, identifying gaps, assigning internal responsibilities and preparing buyer updates. The focus is practical reporting readiness, not independent verification or legal opinions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who coordinate product scope, supplier evidence and export-market communication for goods that may fall within CBAM. It suits operational professionals who need a practical approach to CBAM reporting without repeating carbon-accounting fundamentals.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with export operations, supplier information or compliance workflows is useful. No carbon-accounting qualification or programming is required; exercises use product information, supplier-data examples and Excel-level tracking.
